title: Slices are tracker sub-issues, and a one-session Change has none
context: Split out of ADR-0045. Slice JSON committed beside the Change pages had to be reconciled at every gate.
decision: A Change's slices are sub-issues under its tracker issue, the same in manual and Symphony mode. A Change that fits one session skips slices and implements directly. The Implements commit trailer is a slice's only durable trace.
consequences: Slices are working notes; nothing in the repository records them beyond commit trailers.
check-workflow.js cannot count slices, so the slice soft target is written only.
